description: List all meetings, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Optional filter: scheduled, completed, or cancelled.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of meeting summaries sorted by start.

description: Retrieve the full meeting object by mid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full meeting including transcript and notes.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new meeting summary.

description: Update one or more fields on an existing meeting.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated meeting summary.

description: Cancel a meeting (sets status to cancelled).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated meeting summary.

description: List scheduled meetings within the next N days from the anchor date.

today.description: Optional ISO anchor; defaults to session's initial time.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of upcoming meeting summaries.

description: List all meetings starting today (or the supplied ISO date).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of meeting summaries starting on that day.

description: List meetings that have already ended.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of past meeting summaries (most recent first).

description: Add an email to the meeting's participant list.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated meeting summary.

description: Remove an email from the meeting's participant list.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated meeting summary.

description: Generate a recording URL for the meeting.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output contains mid and recording_url.

description: Attach or replace the transcript text for a meeting.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output contains mid and character count.

description: Retrieve the stored transcript text for a meeting.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output contains mid and transcript_text.

description: Search meetings by keyword across title, description, notes, and transcript.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching meeting summaries.

description: Get aggregate meeting stats (total, by status, with recording, with transcript).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a stats object.
